description: Real-time web dashboard for pi coding-agent sessions. Multi-session view, live chat mirroring, integrated terminal, diff viewer, pi-flows execution, and mobile-first remote control via mDNS or zrok tunnel. Coexists with pi's TUI — doesn't replace it.
